description: A hijack hidden behind a gap: 1.8.0 was built by acme/widget, 1.9.0 has no provenance but already adds the postinstall, and 2.0.0 is built by mallory/widget. Compared with its semver predecessor nothing changed; compared with the last version that has provenance, the repository and the install script did. Twin: benign-provenance-renamed-repo.
